tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and default surface of every light chapter; body background. `ink`, `ink-2`, `muted`, `signal-ink` read on it; `quiet` is 4.47:1 here (just under AA for small text).

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Recessed light surface: footer, composer-inherit box, inactive panels. Same text pairs as `paper`; `quiet` drops to 4.12:1 here.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Deepest light surface for fills and tracks; text on it should be `ink`, `ink-2` or `muted` (5.00:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, wordmark and the strongest marks on `paper`/`paper-2`/`paper-3` (13.6–15.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: navigation links, footer statement, idle TraceMark strokes. 9.75:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy: chapter intros, inactive choices, footer links. 5.85:1 on `paper`, 5.00:1 on `paper-3`.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Mono metadata (`meta`, trace labels, footer meta, idle language switch). FLAG: 4.47:1 on `paper`, 4.12:1 on `paper-2`, 3.82:1 on `paper-3` — below WCAG AA 4.5:1 at its 11–12px sizes. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders on light surfaces (1px). Decorative separator, 1.36:1 — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: secondary-link underline, input and dot borders, text-button underline. FLAG: 1.82:1 on `paper` — below the 3:1 non-text floor when it is the only edge of an input.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Ground of dark sections (`.dark-section`: Gap, Lab, final CTA, route ends). Same value as `ink`; kept as its own role in the source.

tokens.name: graphite-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface inside dark sections (experiment teaser). `light-muted` reads at 6.18:1.

tokens.name: rule-dark
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders on `graphite` (1.65:1, decorative).

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `graphite` (15.6:1).

tokens.name: light-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `graphite` (10.56:1): intros, inverse TraceMark strokes, light text buttons.

tokens.name: light-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata and trace labels on `graphite` (6.73:1) and `graphite-2` (6.18:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one cobalt signal — semantic only: active relationship, selected path, current system state, connection being established, evidence state, focus ring, primary action fill. White text on it: 5.72:1. As a mark on `graphite` 3.06:1 (passes the 3:1 non-text floor); on `graphite-2` 2.81:1 (FLAG for the focus ring there).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Cobalt as text and hover: link hover, active nav item, composer badge, primary action hover fill. 6.28:1 on `paper`; white on it 6.92:1.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Light cobalt for emphasis text on `graphite` (13.92:1): scrubbed thesis words, active maturity step, experiment highlights.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: 8% cobalt wash behind a selected item (composer-inherit on, active cells) and the 5px halo ring around active dots. Source writes it `rgb(36 89 232 / 8%)`; same colour.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: The only warning colour: added/unnecessary capability, complexity notice, error states. Always paired with a dashed border or a word, never colour alone. 6.16:1 on `paper`.

families.sans: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: brand-word
styles.usage: The hero brand word only. Fluid in code: clamp(72px, 10.5vw, 134px); 134px is the desktop cap.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.sample: Turn AI capability into human capability.
styles.usage: Hero h1, max 20ch, text-wrap: balance. Fluid: clamp(3rem, 5.3vw, 5.3rem); ≤680px clamp(2.6rem, 11vw, 3.4rem) at line-height .96.

styles.name: chapter-title
styles.sample: Capability is not yet a way of working.
styles.usage: Chapter h2 (`.chapter-title`), max 920px, balanced. Fluid: clamp(2.3rem, 4.1vw, 4.1rem); ≤680px clamp(2rem, 9vw, 2.9rem). `ink` on paper, `light` on graphite.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: DYAI designs the layer between human intent, context, AI, tools, workflows and evidence.

styles.name: intro
styles.sample: Choose a situation and inspect how a different problem creates a different human–AI system.
styles.usage: `.chapter-intro` under a chapter title, max 640px, in `muted` (`light-2` on graphite); 15px below 680px.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Bring scattered evidence into view without delegating the decision.
styles.usage: `--text-small`: the most common literal size in component copy (lists, choices, notes). Line height varies 1.4–1.6 in code.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Design the relationships. Increase what people can do.
styles.usage: Footer statement and compact explanatory copy in `ink-2`.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Label of `.action-link` (ButtonLink) and header CTA (13px there).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Primary navigation links in `ink-2`; 12px below 1120px, 15px in the mobile menu.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Header and footer wordmark beside the brand mark; its suffix (STUDIO) is `meta-sm` mono at letter-spacing .1em.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: ILLUSTRATIVE SITUATIONS — NOT MEASURED CUSTOMER CASES
styles.usage: `.meta`: semantic metadata, always UPPERCASE (text-transform), `quiet` on paper, `light-muted` on graphite; a `<b>` inside is `ink`/`light` at 600.

styles.name: trace-label
styles.usage: Chapter eyebrow beside the TraceMark, UPPERCASE; 11px below 680px.

styles.name: meta-sm
styles.usage: Secondary metadata (`--text-meta-sm`), footer meta row, wordmark suffix. The floor: nothing in the system is set below 11px.

fontSize.note: The source's text-size custom properties, emitted as CSS variables for the component stylesheet.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy size; overridden to 16px at ≤680px in the stylesheet.

tokens.name: text-small
tokens.usage: Declared in the source; not referenced by any rule (15px is written literally).

tokens.name: text-meta
tokens.usage: Important metadata (`.meta`, language switch). 12–13px is the metadata band.

tokens.name: text-meta-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary metadata; the minimum text size.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Max content width: `.page-shell` is min(var(--shell), 100% − 2 × gutter).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of every shell and the mobile menu padding.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Sticky header height and scroll-padding offset; 60px at ≤680px.

tokens.name: header-h-compact
tokens.usage: Header height after 48px of scroll (desktop only).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Header compaction (.25s) and GSAP-adjacent CSS transitions. Hover colour changes use plain `ease` at .18s.
